answer: Proof-of-stake identity bounds Sybil attacks by pricing each fake agent. A newcomer locks collateral to mint one non-transferable attestation; a prism of checks (device, funding origin, and social graph) must align before that stake counts. Cloning a falcon a thousand times still needs a thousand independent bonds, and caught fraud slashes every one. The horizon of profit stays below the cost of the bonds, so splitting one voice into many is a losing trade.
